message.anime_multiverse.stone.gate: The stone will not wake: it needs %s base maximum EP.
message.anime_multiverse.stone.container: The stone will not stay in a chest.
message.anime_multiverse.stone.whisper.s: Space bends towards the places you have not been.
Every door is a door you may open.
message.anime_multiverse.stone.whisper.m: I hear them all. They hear nothing of me.
A thought is a door left open.
You need not take a will to know it.
message.anime_multiverse.stone.whisper.p: There is more of me than you can hold.
Strength asks nothing. It only waits.
Spend me, and I will not be less.
message.anime_multiverse.stone.whisper.t: It has already happened. Do it again.
A moment is a place you can return to.
message.anime_multiverse.stone.whisper.r: Say it, and it is so; unsay it, and it never was.
Nothing is fixed that you do not fix.
message.anime_multiverse.stone.whisper.s: The ones you lost are here. They are quiet.
Every soul has a weight. Mine is yours.
What is given is never returned.
